current.label: v1.0.0 (Plan 10) — V10 custody-escrow gateway: settleInvoice routes payouts into a 7-day refund-window escrow; claim()/refundInvoice() are merchant-permissionless, admin can recoverEscrow after grace.
highlights: Custody escrow: settleInvoice transfers grossPayout into the contract and locks it in `escrows[globalId]` for `REFUND_WINDOW` seconds. Merchant claim() drains matured escrows; refundInvoice() during the window returns the customer's amountOut.
Admin recovery: `adminRecoverEscrow(globalIds, to)` sweeps escrows from deactivated merchants after `REFUND_WINDOW + ADMIN_RECOVERY_DELAY`. Batch is atomic — one bad row aborts the call.
recordPayerRefund() — relayer-side terminal failure path when App Kit Swap can't deliver; off-chain refund is paired with an on-chain event so the indexer flips the invoice to 'failed'.
Source for current address: this file. Test setup (`packages/app/test/setup.ts`) and any indexer config that hardcoded the address should be migrated to read here.
